Thanks for the heads up — this looks straightforward but we need the completed vendor-update form (PDF) plus a verification step before changing the payment routing.

Action items: 
1) Karthik / Claire: please complete the enclosed vendor update form and sign via DocuSign. I attached our standard Sunfield_vendor_update_form.pdf for the vendor to sign.
2) Claire: once DocuSign is done, our AP team will perform a micro-deposit verification and then update Workday (vendor ID: V-33921).
3) Neha: please flag PO RWI-2026-1223 for review — if payment date is after the record update, no action needed; if payment clears before update, we should cancel and reissue to the new routing.

I’ve created a short Jira ticket to track this: PROC-4582 (link in thread). I’ll post the micro-deposit status in the ticket.

Attaching: Sunfield_vendor_update_form.pdf (please complete and e-sign)
